links.quote: Positive assortative mating leads to an increase in homozygotes whereas negative assortative mating leads to an increase in heterozygotes.
Positive assortative mating leads to an increase in homozygotes whereas negative assortative mating leads to an increase in heterozygotes.
In contrast, negative assortative mating is breeding between individuals with dissimilar genotypes, and is more rare.
